objective: Predictively load one or two real AdMob Native creatives for likely next public dashboard tab screens before navigation, never as hidden SDK views.
productionBaselineEvidence: Current main focus-gates each ad request to a visible dashboard and preserves loaded creatives on return, but first visits to sibling tabs wait on NativeAd SDK load. Prior staging #855 only implements focus-aware requests. Exact served production OTA not independently verified; provider fill never guaranteed.
chosenApproach: One Android-only persistent tab warmup coordinator, bounded two creative memory pool, 30m freshness, same cooldown, legitimate SDK load only after UMP and safe route/scope/foreground/network/remote approval. First-view claims owned ad only on focus+viewport and falls back to existing sequential BannerAd after preload failure.
selectionRationale: No hidden views, fake impressions, aggressive no-fill retries or native dependencies. Keep all prior focus-aware controls, and restore fast first-view on next tab when filled.
alternativeApproaches: Hidden native ad view: invalid impression risk
Request on every tab navigation: slow, duplicate loads
Preload all dashboard placements: memory and inventory waste
preserveBehaviors: Android Expo runtime 1.3.2, installed AdMob native SDK and all ad IDs unchanged.
Genuine impression callbacks; no prewarm render, click, points or finance credits.
Existing consent, remote flags, safety locks, no-fill and two-minute passive request cooldown.
Current first-view Native-first plus sequential Banner fallback, retained offscreen SDK objects and scroll-stop.
acceptanceChecks: Genuine already-filled Android NativeAd appears on focused first-view without a second SDK request.
No provider view or impression on non-visible tab.
No preload while unconsented, network offline, remotely disabled, locked, in background or on sensitive route.
Two creative cap, 30-min TTL and failed-slot cooldown preserved.
Tests, TypeScript and exact-source CI required before Android RC/OTA.
